doorOffer.promptHtml: The ring of pale light. The too-many-angled faces. The trillions of eyes. The ring waits. Seven doors — some open, some priced beyond you. The choice is which risk you take. ◈ the Feared — 31 distinct monsters faced blow-by-blow. The footage exists, and it plays unasked. (standing: 60) ◇ the Indispensable — The Indispensable needs a full seat — the galaxy must actually need you, not just notice you. ◈ the Beloved — Viewership 44, fan favor 14 — the galaxy's favorite, by the numbers. (standing: 60) ◈ the Witness — 13 exposures on the record. The docket is real. (standing: 60) ◈ the Assimilated — Always open. The table takes anyone — that's what makes it a trap, and what makes it safe. (standing: 5) ◈ the Defiant — Defiance 11 on the record. The 'no' is earned. (standing: 24) ◈ the Relay —

🔥 The fire settles. Olivia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Tick — I put it down today." "It waits. The questing legs wave — the tell." "Adjacent = attached. No dodge. It's ON you." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon mutters "So it bleeds." Zoltan mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
